name: MySQL CDC Source
shortDescription: Stream row-level INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE changes from a MySQL table to a Kafka topic by reading the binary log.

Variables.Name: output
Variables.Description: Kafka topic that receives one message per changed row, keyed `<database>.<table>`

Variables.Name: MYSQL_HOST
Variables.Description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL server to replicate from

Variables.Name: MYSQL_USER
Variables.Description: MySQL user with REPLICATION SLAVE and REPLICATION CLIENT on *.* and SELECT on the table

Variables.Name: MYSQL_TLS
Variables.Description: `true` encrypts without verifying the server certificate; a CA file path (e.g. `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`) encrypts and verifies the certificate and hostname; `false` connects in plaintext

Variables.Name: MYSQL_COMMIT_INTERVAL
Variables.Description: Seconds between producing buffered changes and committing the binlog position; bounds the delay between a change and its message

Variables.Name: MYSQL_SOURCE_NAME
Variables.Description: Leave empty for `mysql_cdc_lite_<database>_<table>`. Sets the state store and replication client id: changing it restarts from the server's current binlog position. Change it only to re-seed after a purged position or to avoid a server_id collision
